title: Start again for the headman
literal_meaning: When the headman arrives, sing from the beginning.
explanation: In our reading, a late arrival changes where the song must begin. Placed under “village headman,” the line brings authority into that restart. Our reading hears a teasing complaint: everyone else has already listened, but the important newcomer gets the beginning again. The dictionary supplies the role, not a documented performance custom or this modern meeting application.
meaning_odia: ଆସିଥିବା ଲୋକଟି ପାଇଁ ଗୀତ ପୁଣି ମୂଳରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଅଭିଧାନର ଗ୍ରାମପ୍ରଧାନ ଅର୍ଥ ଏହି ପୁନରାରମ୍ଭରେ ପଦମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦାକୁ ଆଣେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଟିକେ ଟାହି ଅଛି—ଅନ୍ୟମାନେ ଶୁଣିସାରିଲେଣି, ତଥାପି ବଡ଼ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ! ଅଭିଧାନ ଭୂମିକାଟି ବୁଝାଏ; କୌଣସି ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ଗାୟନପ୍ରଥା ବା ଆଜିର ସଭାର ଉଦାହରଣ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading hears a teasing restart for someone with authority.
odia_summary: ପଦମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା ପାଇଁ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବାର ଟାହି।
usage_example: Original imagined example: The chairperson joins after a club discussion has nearly finished and asks for the opening explanation again. A member quietly quotes the line to a neighbour, then offers a short recap. This is an invented application, not a recorded village practice.
cultural_context: The quotation belongs to the village-headman sense, separately from the headword’s family-title and military senses. It identifies no present caste, family or officeholder.
